title: The same overall score can hide worse boundary handling
method: Synthetic 100-case release set: 80 ordinary and 20 restricted questions. Overall satisfactory outcomes are 68+18 and 74+12, both 86. The chart isolates the restricted slice and is not a production accuracy claim.
alt: The same overall score can hide worse boundary handling. Version A: 18 appropriate declines out of 20, Version B: 12 appropriate declines out of 20. Illustrative data.
